name: uninstall
description: Take back exactly what the install put on this machine, in the reverse of the order it was built: the cluster goes before the addresses it answered on and the files it ran from, and each tool is removed only after the thing it was needed to remove.

steps.description: Removing the cluster and everything running inside it.
Removing the MemQL files this install downloaded.
Removing the cluster's web addresses from the system hosts file, leaving every other entry alone.
Withdrawing this machine's local certificate authority from the system trust stores and deleting the certificate it issued.
steps.sharedReason: The mkcert root CA is per machine, not per project -- it may be signing certificates for your other local stacks. Removing it makes those untrusted too. The front-door certificate and private key MemQL issued go with it; they are MemQL's own and are only removed when MemQL issued them.

steps.description: Removing k3d, now that the cluster it runs is gone.
steps.sharedReason: k3d creates and manages local Kubernetes clusters generally, not only MemQL's.

steps.description: Removing kubectl, now that the cluster it talks to is gone.
steps.sharedReason: kubectl talks to any Kubernetes cluster, not only MemQL's.

steps.description: Removing mkcert, now that the certificate authority it manages is gone.
steps.sharedReason: mkcert issues locally-trusted certificates for any project on this machine.
